plan.variables: 14 signed-square amplitudes on fixed second-read residual eigenvectors; first reads and all existing graph coefficients frozen.
plan.objective: Minimize maximum squared ratio to the unchanged two aggregate coefficient, three component-value and three source-Jacobian bars. These are convex quadratic functions of amplitudes with first read fixed. Opened-state proposal only.
plan.solver: SLSQP analytic quadratics and gradients,1000iterations,ftol1e-12; retain primal violation and nonnegative active-multiplier KKT residual. Numerical stationarity is not a rigorous infeasibility certificate.
plan.controls: 10 planted-compatible and symmetric-incompatible quadratic programs pass across dimensions2,3,5,8,14.

predictions.instrument: Quadratic loss/profile/direct graph replay<1e-8, finite objective, exact1155-per-square price, KKT residual reported.
predictions.fidelity: Primary final maximum squared ratio<=1, confirmed independently through actual graph assessment.

plan.scope: Single node exchange on opened states. Hold14 correction products and original fidelity/cost bars. Gradient-directed proposal versus one seeded random replacement; one random control is descriptive, not a distributional significance test.
